tutor.title: AI tutor
tutor.intro: Ask about anything in your SSC syllabus, in Bangla or English, or send a photo of a written creative answer to get it marked. The tutor explains and guides; it can make mistakes, so check with your textbook.

tutor.signIn: Sign in to use the tutor. It's free; the daily limit keeps it free for everyone.
tutor.empty: Try: "Explain photosynthesis in simple words" or "How do I start part (c) of a CQ?"

tutor.photoHow: Write your answer on paper, then take one clear photo of the page in good light.
tutor.questionHint: Type or paste the question so the marking is fair
tutor.privacy: Your chats and photos are saved to your account so you can continue later. They are not used to train AI. Don't share personal details.
tutor.notLegible: Much of the page was hard to read. Try a sharper photo in better light.
